description:
Experience the perfect blend of luxury, elegance, and exceptional comfort with the Regalia Luxe 3+2 Seater Sofa from New Galaxy Furniture.

Designed to elevate your living space, this premium sofa features beautifully diamond-quilted backrests, plush cushioned headrests, stylish wooden armrest accents, and spacious seating for ultimate relaxation.

Premium Features:

🪵 Strong Neem Wood Frame – Durable, reliable, and termite-resistant construction.

☁️ Duroflex 40-Density Foam – Superior seating comfort with a 5-year cushion warranty.

✨ Premium Suede Upholstery – Soft, water-resistant, and washable fabric for everyday convenience.

🛋️ Elegant Design – Diamond-quilted backrests, comfortable headrests, and premium wooden accents.

🎨 Multiple Colour Options – Choose the perfect shade to complement your interiors.

📏 Customisable Sizes – Tailored to suit your space and requirements.

Dimensions:

- 3-Seater: 78" (L) × 35" (W) × 42" (H)
- 2-Seater: 56" (L) × 35" (W) × 42" (H)
- Seat Depth: 23"
